title: Skin Care for Vadodara Weather: A Routine for Hot Summers, Sticky Monsoons, Garba Nights and Dry Winters
ex: Dry summer heat, a humid monsoon, nine nights of garba and a short dry winter: a simple, season-by-season skin care routine for people living in Vadodara.
rt: Skin Care for Vadodara Weather by Season | Mirc Glow
rd: Skin care for Vadodara weather: sun care for hot dry summers, light layers in the monsoon, a Navratri garba plan and a richer routine for dry winters.
quick: Vadodara is very hot and dry from March to June, humid during the monsoon to September and mild but dry from December to February. Use a gentle face wash and broad-spectrum sunscreen all year, light gel layers in the hot and wet months, and a fuller night cream and lip balm in winter.
facts: Vadodara is in central Gujarat, inland from the coast
March to June is very hot and mostly dry
The monsoon runs roughly late June to September
Navratri garba and Uttarayan on 14 January mean long hours of sweat or sun
